name: Apex XPLR D1 / Rival XPLR E1
use_case: Fully wireless 1x gravel, with different 12- and 13-speed frame constraints
positioning: Apex D1 is the standard-hanger 12-speed route; Rival E1 is the newer 13-speed Full Mount route and requires a UDH-capable frame.
architecture: Fully wireless AXS control with a removable rear-derailleur battery; the two revisions use different cassettes and frame mounts.

weight.note: No combined total is used because Apex D1 12-speed and Rival E1 13-speed are different systems.

battery: Removable AXS rear-derailleur battery plus lever coin cells.
controls_and_app: AXS app supports setup, personalization, battery state and firmware.
package_summary: Apex D1 works with 10-36T, 10-44T or 11-44T XPLR cassettes; the 11-44T route can retain HG. Rival E1 uses the 10-46T 13-speed XPLR cassette and Full Mount.

compatibility.freehub: Apex: HG with 11-44T or XDR with 10T-start cassette; Rival E1: XDR
compatibility.hanger: Apex D1 standard hanger; Rival E1 requires UDH-capable Full Mount frame
compatibility.frame: Rival E1 cannot be fitted to an ordinary non-UDH dropout

china_price_status: No attributable exact mainland Apex D1 or Rival E1 package price captured in this batch.
caveats: Never present 13-speed Rival XPLR E1 as compatible with an ordinary hanger frame.
Do not merge Apex D1 12-speed cassette compatibility into Rival E1 13-speed.
Count XDR, Flattop chain, batteries, brakes and installation parts in the conversion price.
